Regenerate the PBF fixture with `python make_osm_fixture.py brandenburg-latest.osm.pbf strausberg-school.osm.pbf`
(needs `pip install osmium`).

Cut the DGM1 fixtures with `python make_sh_dgm1_fixture.py dgm1_32_565_5949_1_sh_2022.tif schleswig-holstein-dgm1-nw.tif`
and `python make_sh_dgm1_fixture.py dgm1_32_611_5970_1_sh_2022.tif schleswig-holstein-dgm1-lzw-ne.tif 2 0 488 300`.
Cut the NRW DGM1 fixture with `python make_nrw_dgm1_fixture.py dgm1_32_354_5642_1_nw_2022.tif nordrhein-westfalen-dgm1.tif 100`.
Cut the Rhineland-Palatinate DGM1 and DOM1 fixtures with `python make_nrw_dgm1_fixture.py dgm1_32_400_5579_1_rp_2024.tif rheinland-pfalz-dgm1.tif 100`
and `python make_nrw_dgm1_fixture.py dom1_32_400_5579_1_rp_2024.tif rheinland-pfalz-dom1.tif 20`.
Cut the Niedersachsen WCS fixture from the GetCoverage answer for E 551800–552000, N 5803200–5803400 (`dgm_200.tif`) with
`python make_nrw_dgm1_fixture.py dgm_200.tif niedersachsen-wcs-dgm1.tif 50`.
